slots.notes: Fullscreen object-cover looping background videos for the scroll-driven hero slider; autoPlay/muted/playsInline, revealed one into the next via the clip-path ellipse transition.
Center navbar brand mark (currently a 4-leaf clover, 305x304 viewBox, solid white fill). Single-color flat shape that tints to fg; scales h-[32px]..h-[48px] (h-[24px]..h-[32px] when scrolled).
Inline LinkedIn glyph SVG (32x32, fill=currentColor) used in the floating nav and footer social column; inherits text color, turns accent on hover.
Masonry product-gallery background images (Viennese Pastry, Bread, Dessert, Savory, Sweet Treats, Culinary Aid, Ingredient); 3:4 portrait, scale(1.2) ken-burns hover over 6s, blur-in scroll entry.
Full-width background image for the 'Partnering With Us' section with dark overlay content (title + 4 black cards) layered on top.
Looping Lottie animation icons, one per 'Partnering With Us' card (Trusted Sourcing, Food Safety Standards, Operational Efficiency, Expert Support); w-10..w-12 on black card backgrounds.

mechanic: A 400vh sticky hero stacks fullscreen looping videos and reveals each one into the next via a scroll-driven clip-path ellipse() expansion, with per-character GSAP SplitText headline reveals, then ScrollTrigger blur/translate entrances down through masonry gallery, scrubbed word-by-word reveal copy, and a marquee partner loop.
techDelivery: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v3 (CSS-variable HSL tokens) component spec, animated entirely with GSAP 3 (ScrollTrigger + SplitText) and lottie-react; lucide-react for utility icons. No Framer Motion.
reskinNotes: Brand mark, LinkedIn glyph, and clip-path geometry live as hardcoded inline SVG/markup in components, not asset files. Color tokens are space-separated HSL channel triples consumed via hsl(var(--x)) — but the #CB9D06 gold accent is hardcoded as a literal hex across many Tailwind classes (bg-[#CB9D06], text-[#CB9D06], hover states) rather than read from a token, so it must be find-replaced everywhere. All copy (nav menus, addresses, partner names, body essay) is hardcoded in markup. Hero H1 uses a viewport-scaled whitespace-nowrap size (text-[9.7vw]) tuned to the Instrument Serif metrics, so swapping the display font can overflow on one line.
